Thanks again for the demo yesterday. GridOps is excited to move forward with Redwood on GCP Marketplace, but procurement has two asks before we can commit: a reduced marketplace rev-share (they're requesting 20% gross rev-share) and a 5-year minimum term with aligned termination rights.

- Requested marketplace rev-share: 20% (we understand Redwood standard is 30%)
- Contract term: 5 years with annual auto-renew unless either party issues 90-day notice

Can you route this to the team that approves private offer exceptions? We need a written confirmation to share with our CFO and GCP Marketplace Ops.

Thanks,

Team —

Thanks Naomi. Quick assessment: GridOps is strategic (vertical partner + high adoption potential). Standard GCP marketplace rev-share for private offers is 30% for our current model. A move to 20% would meaningfully impact unit economics.

Requesting exec approval for exception. Proposed path for exec consideration:
1) Counteroffer option A: 25% rev-share year 1, step-up to 30% in year 2 onward; 36-month term with optional 24-month extension tied to usage thresholds.
2) Option B (more conservative): 28% rev-share flat for 36 months.

Please provide: 1) Model of impact on contribution margin (Naomi attached redwood-pricing-model) 2) Any strategic rationale (channel acceleration, co-marketing, references) for Vivek's review.

Karthik
Senior Manager, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Deal Desk: GridOps private offer — rev-share & term exception request (RID-2026-1119)

Karthik / Naomi —

Appreciate the summary. I reviewed the numbers and strategic notes. My conditional approval: we can offer Option A with tightened commercial guardrails:
- 25% rev-share for year 1 with a mandatory step-up to 30% on renewal/year 2 onward.
- Term: 36 months initial term with single 24-month extension option exercisable by GridOps only if they hit >150% of year 1 ARR in year 3 (i.e., usage-linked extension).
- No exclusivity; Redwood to retain right to standard marketplace listings.
- Customer must agree to joint GTM deliverables (quarterly business reviews + two co-marketing plays in year 1).

Marissa: can Legal confirm if the above termination/extension language is acceptable for GCP private offer templates and advise on any Marketplace Ops constraints? If legal signs off, Karthik please draft private offer with these terms and send for DocuSign.

Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference

2) GridOps to sign and provide PO to GCP Ops for private listing.
3) Naomi / Rachel to coordinate joint GTM plan.
